name: crouch_check_hold
text: Hold a deep squat with elbows near the knees and torso leaning forward, head tilted down to inspect the ground. Maintain the squat steadily with small natural breathing movement.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 保持低蹲查看地面，双肘靠膝、双手在膝前，独立两秒循环；同名一次性下蹲动作之外的保持段。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
